D1.title: D1 System inventory and data objects
D1.purpose: The landscape as the client's own documents describe it: every system with category, vendor and product, version, owner, hosting and lifecycle; every data object that crosses a system boundary with the systems the documents claim as its master; and the strategic statements the target architecture is derived from. Scope of this study: {landscape.focus}.
D1.sources: corpus/index.json (the indexed client documents with stable locators), analysis/inventory/landscape_inventory.md (the verified inventory)
D1.sources_client: The client's documents (indexed, every statement with a stable document locator) and the landscape inventory verified against them
D1.extra: As-is diagram: the file {deliverables.D1.diagram} is generated from the same data - it is regenerated after every change, never edited by hand.

D3.title: D3 Data flows and single source of truth
D3.purpose: The landscape as one flow list: which data moves from which {system.noun} to which, by which mechanism and how often; for every data object which {system.noun} is the single source of truth, where two documents claim it for different systems, and where nobody claims it at all; and the structural findings that follow from the flow list.
D3.sources: analysis/consolidated/FLOWS.md (the consolidated flow list and SSOT matrix) over analysis/scopes/*.md
D3.sources_client: The consolidated flow list and mastership matrix over the {system.noun} analyses
D3.extra: The as-is diagram deliverables/{deliverables.D1.diagram} is generated from the sheet Flows of this workbook's data source - the picture and the table always agree.

D4.title: D4 Target architecture: options and roadmap
D4.purpose: The target architecture as a decision, not a picture: one row per strategic move the client's own vision asks for - introduce, replace, consolidate, move a master, retire, keep - with the {system.noun_plural} affected, the flows that change, the data objects that get a new master, the prerequisites, the risks and whether it is the recommended way or the alternative that was weighed. The roadmap shows in which order the moves have to happen and what is true for the business at the end of each phase.
D4.sources: analysis/consolidated/TARGET.md (options, roadmap, principles) over analysis/consolidated/FLOWS.md and the strategic statements in D1
D4.sources_client: The consolidated options, roadmap and principles over the flow list and the strategic statements in D1
D4.extra: Target diagram: the file {deliverables.D4.diagram} is generated from the option list - a changed option changes the picture. Strategic frame: {strategy.vision} Horizon: {strategy.horizon}.
